name: 3xmr
description: Connect your agent to 3XMR Research for real historical market data and reproducible strategy evidence. Sign-in requires an approved account.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous market research with your own agent
interface.longDescription: Ask a market question, explore rights-approved historical data, turn trading ideas into falsifiable tests, and review reproducible after-cost evidence with your own AI agent. Private by default; never signals, profit guarantees, or order execution. Sign-in requires an approved account.
defaultPrompt: Use 3XMR to check my account access and show which real markets and dates I can query.
Use 3XMR to investigate a market move and turn my idea into a falsifiable research plan.
